table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname=  item.name, 
			 itempacking.name, 
			packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
			manf=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
			aliasname= item.customicode,
			username=(select username from users where users.usercode=purquotationheader.usercode), 
			
			 purquotationheader.purquotationcode,   
			 purquotationheader.date ,
			 purquotationheader.posted,  
			 purquotationheader.discperc,  
			 purquotationheader.misccharges,  
			 purquotationheader.flatdisc,  
			 
			 purquotationheader.suppcode,  
			 purquotationdetail.icode,  
			
			
			qty =   purquotationdetail.qty,  			
			 purquotationdetail.bonusqty, 
			 purquotationdetail.packunits, 
			 purquotationdetail.purprice,   
			    
			 purquotationdetail.discperc,
			 purquotationdetail.gstperc,
			 purquotationdetail.unitsalestax,
			 purquotationheader.invgstperc1,
   		 purquotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
			 accounts.aliasname,
			SupplierName=LTRIM(RTRIM( accounts.name)) /*+ ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM( accounts.acccode)) + ')'*/,
          purquotationheader.remarks,
			
			/*saleqty = Round(IsNull((Select Sum( saledetail.looseqty)/3
									FROM   saleledger,	 
											 saledetail
									
									WHERE  saleledger.date >= DateAdd(dd,-90, purquotationheader.date) and 	
											 saleledger.date <=  purquotationheader.date and 	
											 saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and	 
											 saleledger.saleinvcode =  saledetail.saleinvcode and	   
											 saledetail.icode =  item.icode  ), 0 ) / CONVERT(float,( purquotationdetail.packunits)),2)
		,*/
			
			salestax=purquotationdetail.unitsalestax						  
												  

	FROM	 
		purquotationheader,   
		purquotationdetail,
		accounts, 
		dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
			
   WHERE	( (  purquotationheader.purquotationcode = :ra_InvCode ) ) and 
			(  purquotationheader.purquotationcode =  purquotationdetail.purquotationcode ) and 
			( purquotationheader.suppcode =  accounts.acccode) and 
			( purquotationdetail.icode = item.icode )
   
ORDER BY 	manf,
				 item.name

objects.name: c_totalsalestax

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc +   misccharges  , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon')) + Round(Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  discperc * 0.01),2)  -  flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)  + sum (c_salestaxval for all), f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(( bonusqty  +  qty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) for all)
